nis2.title: NIS 2 walkthrough
nis2.approvalLead: These documents were written in your company's NIS 2 walkthrough. Read each one and approve it. Your approval is recorded with your name and today's date.
nis2.approvalLeadOthers: These documents were written in your company's NIS 2 walkthrough. Management approves them here, signed in with its own account.

intro.title: You are in the right place.
intro.lead: You have been asked to take care of NIS 2 and do not know where to start? That is how almost everyone feels. We go through it with you, item by item.

points.title: One thing at a time
points.text: You only ever see one item. We explain it before you enter anything.

points.title: Methods we recommend
points.text: Where a proven method exists, we show it to you. You decide whether to adopt it.

points.title: Leaving things open is fine
points.text: What cannot be done yet, you set aside and carry on with the next item.

points.title: Approval at the end
points.text: Management reviews everything and approves it.

gdpr.title: GDPR walkthrough
gdpr.approvalLead: These documents were written in your company's GDPR walkthrough. Read each one and approve it. Your approval is recorded with your name and today's date.
gdpr.approvalLeadOthers: These documents were written in your company's GDPR walkthrough. Management approves them here, signed in with its own account.

intro.title: The GDPR, item by item.
intro.lead: Data protection officer, record, service providers, security, breaches and requests: we go through selected duties of the GDPR with you and write the documents your company needs for them along the way.

points.title: What you already have
points.text: Your supplier list and your security documents from the NIS 2 walkthrough are carried over where they fit.

points.title: Suggestions, not blank pages
points.text: Every activity on the record comes with a suggestion. You use it or change it.

points.title: Clear about what is missing
points.text: The walkthrough covers selected duties, not the whole GDPR. The first step says what it does not cover yet.

points.title: Approval at the end
points.text: Management reviews all documents and approves them. The GDPR does not ask for a signature.
